_comment: Taiwanese researchers presenting at COLM 2026. `papers` are ids from papers.json (main conference) or from extraPapers below (workshop papers, which are not in the accepted list). Titles, authors, rooms and poster numbers of main-conference papers are resolved by scripts/build_data.py — only names and ids live here. Workshop papers: title/authors from OpenReview (colmweb.org/COLM/2026/Workshop/*), room from the workshop's entry in workshops.json (colm.cc), posterWindows from the workshop's own website schedule (neither site says which of the two sessions a paper is in).
